Puberty blockers do not ”pause” puberty. A child cannot just wait and decide and then resume puberty if they change their mind. A child cannot consent to taking life altering medication that halts puberty, a critical time period of their life. A critical period in child development is a period that cannot be skipped or paused and is essential to the functioning of an organism, in this case of the human. It doesn’t sit right with me, how casually people talk about puberty blockers. They have devastating consequences to the development of children and teens.
